findings.description: The function's environment variables embed a literal AWS access key ID and secret access key ("AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE" / "wJalrXUtnFEMI/K7MDENG/bPxRfiCYEXAMPLEKEY") directly in the Terraform source. These are stored in plaintext in state and in the Lambda console environment, readable by anyone with lambda:GetFunctionConfiguration, and should be supplied via Secrets Manager/SSM or an execution role instead.

The function uses runtime "nodejs12.x", which is end-of-life and no longer receives security patches from AWS. Running on an unsupported runtime leaves known Node.js and bundled-dependency vulnerabilities unpatched in the execution environment.
